name: Ayasato Chihiro
source:
Head of her own criminal defense law firm, Mia Fey is [url=/c3941]Phoenix Wright[/url]'s boss and mentor.

Always cool under pressure, Mia Fey is smart, tenacious, a strict teacher, and sometimes even coy. She has a great affection for her sister [url=/c3944]Maya[/url], but is also very independent, and strives to uncover truth at all costs.

[spoiler]Though she was murdered shortly after Wright's career began, she would continue to assist him on occasion by possessing the body of either Maya or her cousin [url=https://vndb.org/c14355]Pearl[/url]. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.court-records.net/chara-mia.htm]Court Records[/url]]
